title: Aoyagi Toya — Maybe Someday〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't by chance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's because you got over whatever was going on between you and your dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I really enjoyed the last event.
And what happened with my dad...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's been a while since I felt this good.
I'd like to get some practice in...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But we all agreed to take a break today.
Maybe I'll just relax listening to some music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Come to think of it,
Akito lent me that CD and... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's this...?
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay, good to see you!
Come sit with us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome. Is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We don't have practice today, so I thought I'd come here and just listen to some music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And if it's alright with you...
Would you mind putting this CD on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is it classical music?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It's a recording of my dad's solo concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't stand the sight of it, so I put it away and forgot about it until coming across it by chance today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. And you felt like giving it another listen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I thought that if I listened to it here after telling my dad how I felt about music, then I could finally appreciate it for what it is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, sounds good.
We can all listen to it together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm curious to hear what your dad sounds like too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, Len. It's classical music.
Won't you just fall asleep halfway through?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, it won't! And if you fall asleep listening, Rin, I'll doodle all over your face!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Challenge accepted!
I'll do the same to you if you doze off!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I made the right call coming here.
I'd just overthink things again if I were alone...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, shall I go and put the CD on?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That was really awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I loved the third piece the best. It felt so sad that my heart sort of began to sink, but at the same time, that was what I really liked about it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I liked the one towards the end. It felt like a piece where a lot of people would be singing and dancing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally get that!
I had the same image in my head too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right? Toya, your dad's amazing.
How does he play like that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks. I feel proud of being his son after hearing that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It changed my impression of your dad too, you know.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on what I heard about him from you earlier, I thought he was a cold and strict person, but his performance was very rich and colorful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well, he is very strict.
Especially when it comes to classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be due to his playing style as well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What about his style?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's all about his steadfast conviction when it comes to performing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: His goal is to flawlessly portray the composer's thoughts or intentions.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He not only learns the actual music, but also researches the composer and their surrounding musical composition until he knows all there is to know about them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By doing this, he recreates the composer's vision for a piece in his head and plays accordingly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow...
That's incredibly thorough...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's also why he despises anything that deviates from the composer's original vision, such as different arrangements, additions and such...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I used to look up to Dad since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But he also put me under pressure.
He wanted me to play the same way as him...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yet you're putting him in such a good light now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I'm finally glad that I can listen to my dad's music and feel respect for him instead of stress...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's great, Toya.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Toya, if it's alright with you,
would you mind if I borrowed this CD for a bit?
I'd like to listen to it some more.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, let me treat you to some coffee jelly.
You know, as a small token of my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here you go. And for Rin and Len, I have fruit jelly! I only made enough for three, so you get to be the lucky ones today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay, treats!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome! Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'm sure we will.
